message.content:
An editorial illustration features a large, muscular man in tan military fatigues standing in the center. He wears a matching field cap and dark, heavy boots. His upper body is tan, while his trousers and the puddle he stands in feature a green, brown, and black camouflage pattern. The camouflage pattern appears to be melting or dripping from his shirt down onto his pants and into the puddle. He holds a large, grey umbrella with many irregular holes. The name "ASABRI" and a blue winged crest are on the umbrella's surface.

Behind him, the large red word "TEMPO" is partially obscured. Above this, the text reads "KESAKSIAN BARU KASUS JOKO TJANDRA" and "MANUVER PRABOWO BELANJA SENJATA." To his right, bold black text states "MENANTI ASABRI," followed by a smaller paragraph in Indonesian. A QR code is in the bottom left, and a barcode with the date "9-15 NOVEMBER 2020" and price "RP 45.000" is in the bottom right. The background is a solid off-white color with a vertical red band on the far left.
